suggestions: Add a deterministic wraparound regression test with an intervening completed operation at the generation boundary; the current arithmetic appears correct for one intervening generation but the boundary deserves explicit coverage.

Out-of-scope existing interaction: start_server_worker still uses post-spawn local_client(&profile)? without clearing the starting slot or reaping the child on error. A later Stop can signal the already-exited worker and time out; this correction does not repair that path.
summary: The Stop correction is statically sound: it rechecks ownership, protects against replacement generations, preserves the reservation through server mutation, and introduces no security issue or lock-order deadlock.
